svg.title: Dust-suppression cannon — Rykbindibyssa
svg.desc: A tapered mist cannon sits on a wheeled support and sends three sparse spray paths from its broad circular mouth.
svg.metadata: {"collection":"UteamUP Construction and Building","subject":"build-dust-suppression-cannon","label_en":"Dust-suppression cannon","label_is":"Rykbindibyssa","section":"03","category_en":"Site setup, surveying and ground investigation","category_is":"Aðstaða, landmælingar og jarðkönnun","batch":2,"tags":["site-setup","dust-control"],"description":"A tapered mist cannon sits on a wheeled support and sends three sparse spray paths from its broad circular mouth.","design_note":"A barrel-like fan housing, support yoke and outward mist distinguish the cannon from a simple speaker or light.","style":{"viewBox":[0,0,24,24],"stroke":"#1655A6","stroke_width":0.9,"fill":"none","background":"transparent"}}
